research_rationale:
EO 13227 established the President's Commission on Excellence in Special Education and contains no provision other than those of a commission order (membership, mission, administration, reports, termination). Its termination clause reads "(e) The Commission shall terminate 30 days after submitting its final
report, unless extended by the President." That clause is triggered by the date of a report and is not an end under owner ruling 2026-10-21-report-deadline; the report date is not held in any source in the repository, so it is disclosed here and not recorded as an end. Section 3 of EO 13316 of September 17, 2003 (68 FR 55255, published September 23, 2003)  revokes the order by number with the words "(c) Executive Order 13227, as amended by Executive Order 13255, estab-
lishing the President ’s Commission on Excellence in Special Education;" and the first dated end held is 2003-09-30. EO 13255 of February 6, 2002 amended section 3(b) by replacing April 30, 2002 with July 1, 2002 (a report date), recorded as a later event on the clause it amends.
